name: Richard Hudson

items.text: At an April 2012 Tea Party forum, Hudson said "there's no question President Obama is hiding something on his citizenship." Two days later Roll Call reported he stood by the remark. He said he hadn't personally seen the birth certificate, which Obama had already released.
items.why: His own words from 2012 are on record, but no finding of wrongdoing bears on any of the owner's criteria, so it is shown without counting.

items.text: On December 10, 2020, Hudson was listed among House Republicans who joined a Supreme Court friend-of-the-court brief backing Texas's suit over the 2020 results in four states. The brief argued that officials outside the legislatures had unconstitutionally changed election rules. It asked the Court to review the matter.
items.why: This is his own filing and it was widely reported, but there is no finding of misconduct and no clear bearing on the owner's criteria, such as self-dealing or lying about his record.
